urdu.name: راشد
urdu.long_meaning: Raashid (راشد) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم راشد، ہدایت یافتہ ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: راشد
persian.long_meaning: Raashid (راشد) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن راشد، هدایت‌یافته است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: राशिद

pashto.long_meaning: Raashid (راشد) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې راشد، سم لارښود ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.long_meaning: Raashid (رَاشِد) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الرَّاشِد، الْمُهْتَدِي. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

name_story.story: Raashid can be understood through the Arabic form رَاشِد, whose central sense is raashid; rightly guided. Raashid is Arabic رَاشِد (Rāshid) 'rightly guided', from the root ر ش د (r-sh-d). The source gloss 'Rightly Guided' is consistent. Same name as rachid.

faq.a: Raashid is associated with the Arabic form رَاشِد, whose core sense is raashid; rightly guided.

faq.q: What is the origin of Raashid?
faq.a: Raashid is associated with Arabic. Raashid is Arabic رَاشِد (Rāshid) 'rightly guided', from the root ر ش د (r-sh-d). The source gloss 'Rightly Guided' is consistent. Same name as rachid.
Yes — the underlying form رَاشِد is Arabic.
Raashid can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Raashid should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Raashid mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Raashid is rendered راشد and carries the sense راشد، ہدایت یافتہ.

faq.q: What does Raashid mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Raashid is rendered راشد and carries the sense راشد، هدایت‌یافته.
A romanized syllable approximation is raas-hid. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Raashid?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Raashid, raashid, rashid. Script forms are راشد, رَاشِد, राशिद.

faq.q: Is Raashid a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
